To remove excess moisture in small spaces, simply place the rechargeable dehumidifier in your desired location, such as in small spaces like cabinets, safes, or cars, to absorb the excess moisture. nameZh: 普樂氏全自動麵包機 (750G)
descZh: 產品特性： 一按即焗，全自動攪拌、揉麵、發酵及烘烤 19項預設程式：烘烤、麵包、蛋糕、果醬、乳酪等 設有三種烘焙顏色（淺、中、深）功能 約15小時預約功能，使用簡單方便 約60分鐘保溫功能 液晶體顯示屏 低噪音運作設計 易提手挽 配件包括攪拌葉、量杯、量勺、鈎棒 容量：750g 電壓：220-240V~ 功率：發熱 450W；摩打 50W 尺寸: 約 20cm(長) x 30cm(闊) x 27cm(高) 19項預設程式： 基本麵包：攪拌、發酵和烘烤。適用於白色和棕色麵包，口味純正，也可以增加香料和葡萄乾調味。 法式麵包：攪拌、發酵和烘烤，但發酵時間較長，烘烤溫度低。製作的脆皮的麵包。 甜味麵包：攪拌、發酵和烘烤，烘烤溫度較低。製作的麵包比較鬆軟香甜。以非常快速的方式揉搓、上升和烘烤，但是烤麵包是所有麵包菜單中最粗糙的。 特快麵包：攪拌、發酵和烘烤（加發酵粉和蘇打），但是製作的麵包是最粗糙的。 快速麵包：攪拌、發酵和烘烤（加發酵粉和蘇打）。製作時間較基本麵包要短，但麵包的內部組織一般比較稠密。 西式蛋糕：製作蛋糕，要用專用的蛋糕粉，加蘇打或泡打粉。 歐式甜點：攪拌和烘烤，脂肪、蛋白質含量較高，味道香甜而不膩口，且式樣美觀，可添加各種口味。 米飯麵包：主要用剩米飯和麵包以1:1的方式，經攪拌、發酵、烘烤成米飯麵包。 粟米麵包：將粟米與麵粉混合，製成麵包。 無麩質麵包：攪拌、發酵和烘烤，針對麩質不耐症等人群，主要用無麩麵包粉、米粉、紅薯粉、粟米粉、燕麥粉製作。 八寶粥：攪拌和燉製成粗糧粥，例如：八寶粥。 韓式年糕：糯米和水加熱，攪拌碾碎製成，味道香甜可口，營養豐富。 漫速和麵：攪拌。使麵和水或其它液體充分混合。 自發麵團：攪拌和發酵。 自訂和麵：按使用者自己對和麵的份量和效果，定義和麵時間。 米酒：糯米發酵而成，蜜香濃郁，人□甜美，易消化吸收，是營養佳品。 乳酪：發酵，製作活性乳酪。 果醬：攪拌，加熱製作果醬。 烘烤：僅烘烤，不攪拌和發酵。可以說明其它功能表增加烘烤時間。
descEn: Product Features: Mixes, kneads, rises and bakes bread automatically with a "Sart" button 19 preset program: bake, bread, cake, jam, yogurt, etc With 3 crust colour options (light, medium and dark) Approx. 15 hours preset function Approx. 60 minutes keep warm function LCD display Low noise design Handle for easy moving With kneading blade, measuring cup, measuring spoon, hook Capacity: 750g Voltage: 220-240V~ Power: heating 450W; Motor 50W Dimensions: 20cm(L) x 30cm(W) x 27cm(H) Approx. CM 19 Preset Program: Basic bread - For white and mixed breads, it mainly consists of basic bread flour. French bread - For light breads made from fine flour. Normally the bread is fluffy and has a crispy crust. This is not suitable for baking recipes requiring butter, margarine or milk. Sweet bread - For breads with additives such as fruit juices, grated coconut, raisins, dry fruits, chocolate or added sugar. Due to a longer phase of rising the bread will be light and airy. Ultra-fast - Kneading, rising and baking in a very fast way. But the baked bread is the roughest one among all bread menus. Quick bread - Kneading, rising and baking time is shorter than basic bread but longer than Ultra-fast bread. The bread interior tissue is denser. Quick breads are made with baking powder and baking soda that activated by moisture and heat. For perfect quick breads, it is suggested that all liquids be placed in the bottom of the bread pan; dry ingredients on top, during the initial mixing of quick bread batters, dry ingredients may collect in the corners of the pan, it may be necessary to help machine mix to avoid flour clumps. If so, use a rubber spatula. Cake - Kneading, rising and baking occurs, but rise with the aid of soda or baking powder. Dessert - Kneading and baking those foods with more fat and protein. Rice bread - Mix cooked rice into the flour with 1:1 to make the bread. Corn bread - Mix corn into the flour with to make the bread. Gluten-free bread - For the bread of gluten-free flours and baking mixtures. Gluten-free flours require longer for the uptake of liquids and have different rising properties. Gruel - Kneading and stewing to make coarse cereals gruel, e.g., Chinese Babao gruel. Sticky rice - Kneading and baking the mix of polished glutinous rice and rice. Mix - Stir to let the flour and liquids mix thoroughly. Dough - This program prepares the yeast dough for buns, pizza crust, etc., to bake in a conventional oven. There is no baking in this program. Knead - Kneading only, no rising or baking. Used for making dough for pizzas etc. Rice wine - Rising and baking the polished glutinous rice. Yogurt - Ferment to make the yogurt. Jam - Use this setting for making jams from fresh fruits and marmalades from oranges. Do not increase the quantity or allow the recipe to boil over the bread pan into the baking chamber. Should this happen, stop the machine immediately and remove the bread pan carefully. Allow to cool a little and clean thoroughly. Bake - For additional baking of breads is needed because a load is too light or not baked through. In this program, there is no kneading or rest.

nameZh: 普樂氏高效能負離子冷風機
nameEn: PROLUXURY HIGH EFFICIENCY ANION AIR COOLER
descZh: 產品特性/功能： 4段風速選擇：低、中、高、強，風量大且噪音低 15小時定時選擇 設有負離子風選擇 左右自動搖擺送風 設有頂部水箱設計，配合機身底部水箱，加水更方便 備有缺水提示聲響 配備遙控器，方便易用 四種模式： 正常模式：按風速鍵設定的強、高、中、低四種風速 自然模式：冷風機按預編程式類比自然風，送出的風使人感到清新、自然 睡眠模式：冷風機按預編程式類比送風，送出低檔輕柔的風 負離子：在機身操作面板按開機後，已預設自動啟動內置的負離子產生器開始工作，釋放負離子，有相對應的指示燈顯示，或可用遙控器單獨關閉或啟動負離子功能 產品規格： 電壓：220-240V~ 功率：65W 包裝尺寸：42cm(L) x 37cm(W) x 88cm(H) 包裝重量：8.7kg
descEn: Product Features: 4 speed levels: low, normal, high, strong; strong air volume with low noise 15 hours timer setting Equipped with anion generator Auto oscillation function from left to right Top water tank equipped with the bottom water tank together, which can make it easier to add water With water shortage alarm Equipped with a remote control 4 Modes: Normal: the air cooler blows the constant wind according to the low, medium, high and strong wind set by the wind speed key Natural: the air cooler is analogous to the natural wind according to the preset program; the strong and weak changes of the wind sentout make people feel fresh and natural Sleep: the air cooler blows the wind according to the computer's pre-programmed analogy, blow a soft gentle wind Anion: after pressing the ON/OFF key on the control panel, anion function is pre-set which automatically to be run from built-in negative ion generator, and the corresponding indicator light will be turned on, or using remote control to turn off or start the anion function independently Product Specifications: Voltage: 220-240V~ Power: 65W Package dimensions: 42cm(L) x 37cm(W) x 88cm(H) Package weight: 8.7kg

nameZh: 普樂氏冷風機-8L
descZh: 產品特性： 提供三段風速調節，配合獨立冰風模式，客製化您的專屬涼意 冷風降溫原理：將冷水或冰凍的冰種放入機內，水泵將從水箱中抽取水並將其倒入蜂窩狀降温水簾紙上，再由轉動的風輪把水簾紙周圍具有一定濕度的冷空氣吹出，吹來的涼風降低了溫度，產生令人放鬆的冷卻效果 獨特的分離式結構，僅需輕啟彈簧扣，水箱與機身便能靈巧拆卸 橫向扇葉可左右自動擺動，縱向扇葉則可依需求手動上下調校，提供廣角送風功能 8公升大容量水箱搭配兩個冰種，為您支撐整晚的持續清涼 靈活移動，配備底部萬向輪與側邊隱形提手，客廳、臥室或書房隨處可用 產品規格： 包裝尺寸：32.4cm(W) x 30cm(D) x 46.4cm(H) 包裝重量：5.1kg 產品尺寸：27.2cm(W) x 26cm(D) x 58.5cm(H) 產品重量：4.2kg 電線長度：140cm 電壓：220-240V~ 功率：60W
descEn: Product Features: Personalize your cooling experience with three adjustable wind speeds and the cool mode Cool mode: add cold water or frozen ice packs into the unit, and the pump will circulate the water onto a honeycomb cooling pad. As the internal fan rotates, it blows air through the damp pad to release refreshing, humidified cool air, effectively lowering the temperature and creating a relaxing cooling effect Featuring a unique detachable design - simply release the spring buckle to effortlessly separate the water tank from the main body Enjoy wide-angle airflow with horizontal vanes that oscillate automatically and vertical vanes that can be manually adjusted to your preference The large 8-liter water tank and two ice packs ensure a continuous, refreshing breeze that lasts all night long Move it with ease - equipped with 360° casters and hidden side handles, it’s perfect for your living room, bedroom, or study Product Specifications: Packing size: 32.4cm(W) x 30cm(D) x 46.4cm(H) Packing weight: 5.1kg Product size: 27.2cm(W) x 26cm(D) x 58.5cm(H) Product weight: 4.2kg Cord length: 140cm Voltage: 220-240V~ Power: 60W

nameZh: 普樂氏電熱水瓶2.4L
descZh: 產品特性： 3種出水模式：電動、氣壓、碰杯 備有再沸騰功能、除氯功能及安全鎖定功能 304不銹鋼內膽，經久耐用 設水位計，方便查看水位 過熱保護裝置，安全可靠 可拆卸上蓋，清洗更方便 出水方式： 氣壓出水：上蓋旋鈕指針的箭頭旋向「ON」，向下按「氣壓出水按鈕」，熱水即由出水口排出。當把上蓋的旋鈕指針箭頭旋向「OFF」，「氣壓出水按鈕」就不可使用。 電動出水：先長按一下「鎖定解除」按鍵，鎖定解除指示燈熄滅，然後按「電動出水」按鍵，熱水即由出水口排出。5-10秒内電動出水功能也會自動上鎖，鎖定解除指示燈亮起。 碰杯出水：先長按一下「鎖定解除」按鍵，鎖定解除指示燈熄滅，再用杯口朝上碰一下出水口旁邊的出水掣，熱水即由出水口排出。5-10秒内碰杯出水功能也會自動上鎖，鎖定解除指示燈亮起。 清潔方法： 機身：以乾身軟布抹擦 *對於難除污垢，請用擰乾的軟身濕布。(切勿以濕布清潔控制面板) *為避免機身變形或破裂，切勿使用揮發性、稀釋劑及液體清潔劑清洗。切勿用含化學物質的布料清潔，否則可能會令機身變色。 *請不要將本產品放入洗碗機/乾碗機。 内膽：請用海綿及清水抹擦 *請勿使用去污粉、鋼絲刷或尼龍刷清潔內膽。 清除水垢：使用過程中，水中礦物質成份或會附於内膽，成爲「水垢」，多為乳白色、紅色黑色圓點或帶有閃光微粒，一般可以使用幾片切片檸檬或檸檬酸清洗（建議2-3個月清洗一次）。 注意：請選用檸檬酸（通常是2湯匙）、白醋等除垢材料。 產品規格： 包裝尺寸：28cm(W) x 28cm(D) x 32cm(H) 包裝重量：2.47kg 產品尺寸：31.5cm(W) x 22.5cm(D) x 29.7cm(H) 產品重量：2kg 電壓：220-240V~ 功率：700-900W 容量：2.4L
descEn: Product Features: 3 ways of water dispense: electric pump, air pump, cup push Re-boiling, dechlorination, safety lock function 304 stainless steel inner pot, strong and durable Water level gauge for easy viewing Overheat and dry-burning protection, safe to use Detachable lid design, easy to clean Ways to Dispense Water: Air Pump Dispense: turn the arrow on the upper cover knob pointer to "ON", press the "Manual Dispense" downward, and the hot water will be discharged from the water outlet. When the knob pointer arrow on the upper cover is turned to "OFF", the "Manual Dispense" cannot be used. Electric Dispense: first long press and hold the "Unlock" button, the unlock indicator light is off, and then press "Dispense" button, the hot water will be discharged from the water outlet. Within 5-10 seconds, the electric dispense function will also be automatically locked, the Unlock Indicator light is on. Cup Push Dispense : first long press and hold the "Unlock" button, the unlock button light is off, and then use the cup to puss the button behind the water outlet and the water will dispense. This function will be automatically locked within 5-10 seconds, the unlock indicator light will be on. Clean and Maintenance: Body: wipe the pot body with a dry soft cloth. *To move heavy dirt, wipe it with a cloth wrung tightly. (Never use a wet cloth for cleaning) *To avoid deformation or cracking, do not use benzine, thinner or liquid cleaners. *Chemical cloth may cause the changes in color of the unit. *Do not wash the product by dishwasher or dish dryer. Inner pot: wipe the inner pot with sponge. *Don't use detergent, stainless-steel brush or nylon brush. Clean limescale: the limescale is mostly in milky white, red, black rust. During use, the mineral components in the water may be attached to the inner tank, and the "scale" is mostly milky white, red and black dots or with glittering particles. Generally, you can use a few slices of lemon or citric acid to clean (recommended to clean once every 2- 3 month). Product Specifications: Packing size: 28cm(W) x 28cm(D) x 32cm(H) Packing weight: 2.47kg Product size: 31.5cm(W) x 22.5cm(D) x 29.7cm(H) Product weight: 2kg Voltage: 220-240V~ Power: 700-900W Capacity: 2.4L
